reason: I'd use the free visit for sure, and with a 4-year-old and a 10-month-old a calm, gated indoor spot where I can sit with a coffee is worth $13 on a rainy or hot day. I'd probably come a couple of times a month, not enough to justify a membership.
objection: Storytime and the parks are free, so I'd only pay if it's really calm and clean. I also can't tell if I could get any work done there, since nothing says there's wifi or a quiet corner.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that it really stays uncrowded and clean, plus wifi and a seat where I can open a laptop while both kids play within sight.
